def factor_volume_weighted_return_shadow_gated(df):
    """Volume-weighted return spread, emphasizing days with dominant lower shadow."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol = df_copy["volume"]
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    lower_shadow = np.minimum(df_copy["open"], df_copy["close"]) - df_copy["low"]
    upper_shadow = df_copy["high"] - np.maximum(df_copy["open"], df_copy["close"])
    lower_dom = (lower_shadow - upper_shadow) / range_.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    lower_dom = lower_dom.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)
    weight = 1.0 + lower_dom
    vol_w = vol * weight
    vw_ret = (ret * vol_w).rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum() / vol_w.rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    simple_ret = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    factor = vw_ret - simple_ret
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_volume_weighted_return_shadow_gated")
description: Primary mechanism is the volume-weighted return spread from pvcoherence_vw_ret_spread_gen0_1: comparing volume-weighted to equally weighted returns to measure coherent price-volume flow. Borrow the lower-shadow dominance concept from alpha-tail-risk-gen0-a-001 as a bounded weight on volume: days with a larger lower shadow relative to upper shadow get extra volume weight, emphasizing sessions where intraday order flow shows pronounced lower-wick activity. This modifies the coherence measure without adding a second independent signal, aiming to improve RankIC and payoff by focusing on volume-confirmed lower-shadow moves. Cross-sectional transform is none because the raw signal retains meaning.
